# Swage

> Agent-facing documentation index for Swage, a context-governed agent platform that runs on your own hardware. Each linked page is the terse, canonical rendering of its subject; llms-full.txt carries the whole set in one file.

## General

- [Agents and permissions](agent-docs/agents-and-permissions.md): Agent definitions, operator guidance (AGENTS.md), tool permissions, approval mechanics, dispatch-bound grant intersection, effort resolution, and space-targeted session creation
- [First session](agent-docs/first-session.md): First-session walkthrough — open a space, optionally attach and trust a workspace, start a conversation with a chosen agent
- [Interfaces and tooling](agent-docs/interfaces-and-tooling.md): Turn context inspector, image attachments and reference admission, page templates and annotations, delivery targets, device registration, wire error contract, route manifest and OpenAPI projection, verification gate, and client-side route handling
- [Workflow engine](agent-docs/workflow-engine.md): Run lifecycle, journal/replay, budget partitions (including per-route), run detail (dispatch, provider rounds, usage, liveness, worktree completion, termination), parking, wake gate, worker sessions, cancellation, failure handover, and carried workflows
